title: 公园一日游

explanations.1: '块' is a measure word used with '一' to form '一块儿', meaning 'together'.
explanations.2: '了' indicates the completion of the action of going to the park.
explanations.3: '很' is an adverb modifying '好' to express 'very good' weather.
explanations.4: '里' is a location noun meaning 'inside the park'.
explanations.5: '先' indicates the first action of walking by the lake before sitting.
explanations.6: '正' describes an ongoing action of seeing the bird.
explanations.7: '只' is a measure word for small animals like birds.
explanations.8: '杯' is a measure word for cups of juice.
explanations.9: '不' negates the verb '想' in the phrase '想不想' to form a question.
explanations.10: '条' is a measure word for long, thin objects like boats.
explanations.11: '上' indicates the surface of the lake.
explanations.12: '真' emphasizes the beauty of the scene.
explanations.13: '还' adds additional information about seeing ducks.
explanations.14: '几' is an interrogative pronoun used to ask about an unspecified number.
explanations.15: '都' refers to all family members sharing the feeling.

translation: Last Sunday morning, my dad, mom, and I went to the park together. The weather was very good, bright and sunny. There were many flowers and trees inside the park. We first took a walk by the lake, then sat on a bench to rest. I just saw a little bird singing in a tree. Mom took out two cups of juice, and we drank them. Dad asked me if I wanted to row a boat. I said, "Great!" We rented a small boat. The lake's surface was sparkling, really beautiful. I rowed for a while and felt tired. Mom said, "Let's go home." I was very happy because today was good. We also saw several ducks. We all felt this outing was very enjoyable.
